items.title: Parasite Outbreak Fears Crush Restaurant Sales Weeks After RFK Jr. Said It Was “Under Control”
items.summary: Three weeks after a Cabinet secretary declared a parasite outbreak under control, a national salad chain collapsed into bankruptcy and a healthy food brand that never even stocked the recalled lettuce watched its stock crater 35 percent.

items.title: MCD Stock Forecast: Here’s Where It’ll End The Year
items.summary: McDonald's has lost ground all year, and the bear case carries real teeth, but a combination of loyalty scale, a new U.S. president, and a beverage platform rolling out ahead of plan may tell a different story by December.

items.title: Michigan says it’s OK to start eating salads again as cyclospora outbreak wanes
items.summary: The state, which has been at the center of the biggest cyclospora outbreak in the U.S., said this week that the number new cases of cyclosporiasis has fallen.

items.title: Chipotle Stock Extends Slide After CDC Links Salmonella Outbreak to Jalapeños
items.summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill shares extended their decline after the CDC linked a multistate Salmonella outbreak to jalapeño peppers served at the chain and other Mexican-style restaurants.

items.title: Factbox-US restaurant chains hit by foodborne illness outbreaks
items.summary: Aug 6 () - Foodborne illness outbreaks have repeatedly disrupted U. restaurant chains, triggering recalls, lawsuits and heightened regulatory scrutiny while pressuring customer traffic and sales.
